 Role Overview 

 Provide sexual and blood-borne virus (BBV) testing, treatment, education and prevention services in clinical and community settings. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  Clinical Care  

 
	 
	 Assess clients and provide testing for BBVs (HIV, hepatitis B & C) and STIs. 
	 
	 
	 Collect specimens (blood, swabs) and manage results and follow-up. 
	 
	 
	 Provide treatment, health advice, counselling and referrals within scope of practice. 
	 
	 
	 Support prevention activities such as vaccinations and harm-reduction education. 
	 
 

  Community & Public Health  

 
	 
	 Deliver health education on safer sex, transmission, testing and prevention. 
	 
	 
	 Work with doctors, allied health and community workers. 
	 
	 
	 Assist with contact tracing and public health follow-up. 
	 
 

  Administration & Quality  

 
	 
	 Maintain accurate clinical records and reports. 
	 
	 
	 Contribute to service improvement, audits, education and training. 
	 
 

 Skills & Qualifications 

 
	 
	 Registered Nurse (AHPRA) – essential. 
	 
	 
	 Experience in sexual health, community or public health nursing preferred. 
	 
	 
	 Strong skills in assessment, specimen collection, counselling and education. 
	 
	 
	 Excellent communication, cultural sensitivity and non-judgmental approach. 
	 
	 
	 Postgraduate training in sexual/reproductive health or public health is desirable. 
	 
 

 Work Settings 

 
	 
	 Sexual health clinics 
	 
	 
	 Community and outreach programs 
	 
	 
	 Public health and prevention services

result.description:
Position: Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanic
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $95,000 - $110,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: Ecoplus Mechanical Services
A.B.N. 66 660 929 304
Job Location: Level 13, 60 Castlereagh Street, Sydney, NSW, 2000,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 20 Jul 2026 > 17 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1698-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client is seeking to add an experienced Airconditioning and Refrigeration Mechanic to the Ecoplus Mechanical Services team in Sydney. With decades of industry experience, Ecoplus delivers reliable HVAC and refrigeration installation, maintenance and repair services across commercial and residential environments, including offices, hospitals, schools, data centres, airports, defence facilities, high-rise properties and marine applications.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Install, commission, service and repair residential, commercial and industrial airconditioning and refrigeration systems.
- Diagnose mechanical, electrical and control faults using technical drawings, schematics and appropriate testing equipment.
- Service and maintain split, ducted, cassette, packaged and VRV/VRF airconditioning systems.
- Maintain, diagnose and repair chillers, central plant systems, fan coil units and chilled-water equipment.
- Service commercial refrigeration plant, including cool rooms, display cabinets and temperature-controlled equipment.
- Undertake preventative maintenance, scheduled servicing and reactive breakdown repairs across Sydney customer sites.
- Install and replace compressors, motors, condensers, evaporators, valves, switches, gauges and control components.
- Measure, fabricate and install refrigerant pipework, drainage, ductwork and associated mechanical components.
- Complete brazing, pressure testing, evacuation, leak detection and refrigerant charging in accordance with regulations.
- Commission new and repaired systems and undertake performance testing to confirm correct and efficient operation.
- Carry out electrical fault-finding, component testing and replacement within the authorised scope of the trade.
- Complete compressor replacements, equipment modifications, system upgrades and retrofits where required.
- Provide full lifecycle support across equipment installation, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repair.
- Record faults, repairs, maintenance activities, refrigerant usage and commissioning results accurately.
- Communicate professionally with customers, contractors and site representatives regarding faults and required works.
- Comply with workplace safety, environmental obligations and site-specific operating requirements.
- Work independently and collaboratively with technicians, contractors and manufacturer-trained service personnel.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- A minimum of three years’ relevant experience installing, servicing and repairing airconditioning and refrigeration systems.
- An AQF Certificate III in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration, or an equivalent recognised trade qualification.
- A current Refrigerant Handling Licence and any trade licences or registrations required to perform the role legally in Australia.
- A current Australian driver’s licence and the ability to travel between customer sites across the Sydney metropolitan area.
- Demonstrated experience with commercial or industrial HVAC systems, including chillers, central plant or VRV/VRF equipment.
- Demonstrated ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical and control faults and complete reliable repairs or component replacement.
- Competence in brazing, leak detection, pressure testing, evacuation, refrigerant recovery, charging and system commissioning.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings and schematics, maintain accurate service records and work safely with limited supervision.

Please include Reference: J1698-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.
